description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'ExceptionToAcknowledgementConverter' responsible for converting exceptions, particularly 'DittoRuntimeException' and other general exceptions, into 'Acknowledgement' objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It handles extracting payloads, status codes, and message details from exceptions to generate structured acknowledgements for messaging and error handling purposes.

classes.name: ExceptionToAcknowledgementConverter
classes.description: An abstract class providing logic to convert various exceptions into 'Acknowledgement' messages, with specific handling for 'DittoRuntimeException' instances.

methods.name: convertException
methods.description: Converts any given exception into an 'Acknowledgement', delegating to specific methods based on exception type.

methods.name: convertDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Converts a 'DittoRuntimeException' into an 'Acknowledgement', using its status code and JSON payload.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Creates a JSON payload from a 'DittoRuntimeException', excluding the 'status' field.

methods.name: convertGenericException
methods.description: Converts non-'DittoRuntimeException' exceptions into an 'Acknowledgement' with a generic status code and message payload.

methods.name: getStatusCodeForGenericException
methods.description: Abstract method that subclasses implement to provide specific status codes for generic exceptions.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Creates a JSON object with message and description for a generic exception.

methods.name: getMessageForGenericException
methods.description: Generates a formatted message string indicating the exception type.

methods.name: getDescriptionForGenericException
methods.description: Creates a detailed description string for a generic exception, including cause info if available.
